title: Quick Grilled Uruguayan Beef Skewers
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Uruguay with these grilled beef skewers, featuring char-grilled goodness and melted Grana Padano cheese, all cooked to perfection on a tava griddle.
instructions: Preheat the tava griddle to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the beef strips to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef strips onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the preheated tava griddle and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the beef is cooking, sprinkle Grana Padano cheese over the top of each skewer.
Once the beef is cooked to the desired level of doneness, remove from heat and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the grilled beef skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
